note: s3 wide, reshot with a stronger written action (draw the pencil across the column, lift it clear, lay it down). The still flag is gone and the writing hand travels along the page across the clip, but this is still the quietest shot in the roll — a wide of one person writing. Accepted: it plays 3.2s at the head and 1.8s at the tail of the scene, with a medium and a close between them.

s3 medium, reshot first-to-last-frame against its own start frame. The door that opened behind his shoulder is gone and the pencil stays in his hand for the whole clip; drift 0.002 because the shot has to arrive back where it began.

s4 medium, third take. Shot i2v on Std with the reversed action (radio down to the hip, held, back up beside the face) after the closed-key take came back frozen. Real travel — 2.7% of frame — he stays in shot throughout, and the walk-out of the first take does not recur.

s4 close, reshot first-to-last-frame. The prop no longer morphs: the desk set stays a desk set and he lifts its handheld mic off it and puts it back, once. Known blemish carried from the start frame: a faint letter-shaped mark in the top right corner, outside the action, present in every frame rather than appearing mid-clip. No budget left to regenerate the frame; recorded rather than hidden.
